title: Synoptic Gospels
modules: The Purpose Of The Gospel Of St. Mark
The Purpose Of The Gospel Of St Mark
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the suggestion that he used Mark's Passion narrative but thoroughly reworked it by changing the sequence of some events and. adding additional features from other sources."
Equally possible is the suggestion that he used Mark's Passion narrative but thoroughly reworked it by changing the sequence of some events and. adding additional features from other sources.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the sole bearer of the Spirit."
After his baptism Jesus is the sole bearer of the Spirit.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the Synoptic Gospels, and is the third and longest of the four canonical Gospels of the New Testament."
The Gospel of Luke is one of the Synoptic Gospels, and is the third and longest of the four canonical Gospels of the New Testament.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the gospel of Matthew? 4.0 Conclusion Matthew believed that Jesus understood the real nature of the Law of Moses better than the rabbis and he tried to show this clearly in his Christology."

Self-Assessment Exercise How universal is the gospel of Matthew? 4.0 Conclusion Matthew believed that Jesus understood the real nature of the Law of Moses better than the rabbis and he tried to show this clearly in his Christology.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the first public act of ministry which Jesus did after he had been anointed with the Spirit of God at his baptism."
The preaching in Nazareth is the first public act of ministry which Jesus did after he had been anointed with the Spirit of God at his baptism.
fib: ______ is the only Gospel in the Bible to make explicit use of the term "church" (Matt. 16:18; 18:17).
The Gospel of Matthew is the only Gospel in the Bible to make explicit use of the term "church" (Matt. 16:18; 18:17).
______ is the tax collector whom Jesus called to be a disciple named 'Matthew" (Matt. 9:9-13).
Only in the first Gospel is the tax collector whom Jesus called to be a disciple named 'Matthew" (Matt. 9:9-13).
______ is a collection of various sayings of Jesus without any connecting narrative.
Thomas is a collection of various sayings of Jesus without any connecting narrative.
______ is the most literary of these books, ahead of Saint Paul's epistles.
Luke's style is the most literary of these books, ahead of Saint Paul's epistles.
______ are the first three Gospels in the New Testament: The Gospel of Matthew, the Gospel of Mark and the Gospel of Luke.
The Synoptic Gospels The synoptic Gospels are the first three Gospels in the New Testament: The Gospel of Matthew, the Gospel of Mark and the Gospel of Luke.
